Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that “Helsingfors” is the Swedish form used for Helsingborg and proposed normalizing the birthplace to “Helsingborg, Sweden.” In reality, Helsingfors is the Swedish name for Helsinki (Finland). This misinterpretation would lead to the wrong birthplace and contradicts reliable sources indicating Helsingfors/Helsinki.
